Optimum Large Cap Growth Fund.strategy_change_review_status: DMC remained the named investment manager; its advisory agreement was replaced and ultimate ownership/control changed effective 2025-12-01. The six disclosed sub-adviser portfolio managers and their stated sleeve responsibilities match between March 31, 2025 and March 31, 2026 filings, except Jeff Bourke's title was updated. This supports roster continuity but day-to-day decision continuity remains not established.
Optimum Large Cap Growth Fund.notes: DMC remained the named investment manager. Following Nomura's acquisition of the relevant Macquarie asset-management business, DMC became a series of Nomura Investment Management Business Trust; the prior advisory agreement automatically terminated and a new DMC agreement became effective 2025-12-01. American Century and Los Angeles Capital continued under new agreements. Official published aggregate allocation weights were 48.51%/51.49% on 2025-09-30 and 48.44%/51.56% on 2025-12-31. This does not establish unchanged security-level sleeve holdings, personnel, processes, or day-to-day decisions. Dated March 31, 2025 versus March 31, 2026 prospectus/SAI comparison: all six disclosed sub-adviser portfolio managers remain listed with the same fund start dates; Jeff Bourke's title changes from Vice President, Portfolio Manager to Vice President, Senior Portfolio Manager. The disclosed day-to-day sleeve responsibility descriptions remain materially consistent. This is documentary roster continuity only; actual day-to-day decision continuity remains not established.
